# Language Features: Time & Date

Clocks, the date, delays and timers.

The clock, the date, waiting and timers. The timers [CreateTimer](CreateTimer), [WaitTimer](WaitTimer) and [FreeTimer](FreeTimer) are the simple way to run a loop at a fixed speed.

Back to [Language Features](Language-Features) or the [Command Index](Command-Index).

* [CreateTimer](CreateTimer)
* [CurrentDate](CurrentDate)
* [CurrentTime](CurrentTime)
* [Delay](Delay)
* [FreeTimer](FreeTimer)
* [Microseconds](Microseconds) 〔BlitzLLVM〕
* [MilliSecs](MilliSecs)
